findings.title: Verifier is inline, not spawned agent
findings.body: Current verifier.ts exports validateSpec() function for inline validation. Does not use spawn_agent.

findings.title: Validation contract structure exists
findings.body: ValidationContract interface defined with requiredSections, mustContain, mustNotContain arrays.

findings.title: PASS/FAIL response format exists
findings.body: VerifierResult interface with passed boolean and findings array defined.

overall_summary: Current verifier implements inline validation only. Full spawned-agent verifier with validation contracts is not yet implemented. Edge case tests verify graceful degradation on failure.
